svg.title: UFC Forecast statistics pipeline
svg.desc: A local batch pipeline accepts a pinned real archive or labeled offline synthetic fixtures, verifies raw hashes, validates identities and paired rounds, and normalizes SQLite facts and held gaps. Scheduled refreshes apply nonempty and retention gates, optionally publish MySQL, then activate a local ready pointer. Separate report and research invocations read SQLite; the offline demo asserts its own expected quality gaps and the research model uses strictly earlier observations. Local launchd scheduling and run receipts provide operational evidence without claiming continuous uptime.
